en: The image shows an old, sepia-toned postcard featuring a rural scene with a large tree, a small chapel-like religious building, and several people sitting or reclining on the ground in front of it. There are stone walls and traditional houses in the background, with terraced hills rising behind them. The text at the bottom identifies the location and subject in Italian.
